**Scope check**

Multisite Fleet Manager deliberately does not:

- manage WordPress installations outside this one,
- make outbound HTTP requests or send telemetry,
- claim to be a security scanner (no malware, file-integrity or vulnerability scanning),
- duplicate what Network Admin already does well (creating sites, editing accounts, changing passwords).

If your request touches one of those, say why it still belongs here.
